Type: chair
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Alicia Contemporary Office Chair, 38"H, Oak
Colors: Oak
A mid-century influenced office chair with sloping minimalist arms gets a modern refresh in style and function. Warm rustic wood trim gives it a modern farmhouse appeal. The height and tilt can be adjusted, and it swivels 360 degrees. 24.2"W x 28"D x 38.4"-41.3"H Ashwood frame and legs; 100% linen fabric; foam cushion; iron base A style that blends with traditional, transitional and farmhouse décor 360 degree swivel function; height and tilt of chair can be adjusted Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty. Assembly in 30 minutes or less; assemble seat, insert base and casters
